name: Quo
description: Quo is a next-generation business phone system that helps teams engage customers, collaborate internally, and scale communication with AI — without losing the personal touch. Connecting Quo gives Claude access to your customer conversations across calls, text messages, and contacts. You can ask questions about those interactions to uncover patterns in what customers are saying and where opportunities may be lost. Claude can search, analyze, and summarize conversations to surface insights like Why are we losing deals? What do customers love about our service? What complaints show up most often?

_published_faq.name: How do I add Quo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Quo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Quo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quo provides these MCP tools: send-message, create-contact, update-contact, fetch-call-transcripts, fetch-messages, list-users, list-inboxes, list-contacts, and get-contact.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Quo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Quo in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Quo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Quo is developed by Quo. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
